name: Intellinez Pricing Tables for Elementor
author: intellinezwp

sections.description:
INTLZ Pricing Tables for Elementor adds a flexible pricing table widget to Elementor.

Features include:

  • Multiple design presets
  • Discounted price and discount label support
  • Ribbon labels like “New” or “Best Seller”
  • CTA button text and link controls
  • Feature list bullet style options
  • Detailed normal and hover color controls
  • Rounded corner controls for card and button
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor and add the “INTLZ Pricing Table” widget.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and active.

Can I style each section separately?

Yes. You can style card, heading, price, features, button, and ribbon sections with normal and hover states.
